methodology: Public employer practice/event pages, Pega client sessions and case studies were checked alongside two first-person PegaFest posts. No private profiles, contact databases or outreach were used.
Assessment priorities are our project-learning judgments for a four-year Pega/CSSA integration and production background, not rankings of employer quality or verified qualification.
Named client implementation evidence is distinguished from solution demos, alliance marketing, historical event participation and current job descriptions.
People are included only with a source-supported professional connection. Speaker locations are not converted into residence; event attendees are not treated as a current team roster.

₹35 lakh total CTC is the user's goal and ₹20 lakh-plus remains the broader search threshold. None of these practice sources establishes a role budget, fixed pay, offer probability or remote permission.
Descriptions summarize public claims; they do not reproduce or endorse reported outcome metrics as independently audited results.
limitations: No headcount, current hiring, employee departure, confidential customer identity or compensation estimate was inferred.
Most sources describe global engagements. Bengaluru or India remote must be established by an actual role or employer confirmation.
Some employer pages were available primarily through their public search index; that limitation is stated in their sources and ownership evidence.
Historical PegaFest participation is retained as professional ecosystem context, with exact dates left null where the readable source did not expose them.
Deloitte, KPMG and NTT DATA remain in the broader directory. This bounded depth set favors the nine firms for which concrete relevant project or practice evidence was obtained.
